name: Interaction Prompt
description: A contextual action prompt showing the current target, verb, input glyph, availability, and optional hold progress. It can consume world.hotspot_layer focus or a host-supplied interaction focus event, but it only communicates what is available and never executes the interaction.

inputs.name: placement
inputs.description: Named safe-area placement; targetAnchored requires the host to supply a projected screen point.

outputs.name: currentPrompt
outputs.description: Normalized prompt as {targetId, verb, label, glyph, enabled, unavailableReason, holdProgress}; holdProgress is clamped from 0 to 1.

outputs.name: hitRegion
outputs.description: Touch activation region; activation is still routed to the interaction owner.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the Adventure Interface Shell UI pack (84ece01). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". Nearest in a catalogue search: world.hotspot_layer, which owns hotspots and derives the cursor from their verbs; this only shows the focused target, verb and input glyph, and executes nothing. Library-native.
